name: offlineSensorCount
definition: The number of endpoint agents in scope that the vendor reports as not checking in (offline), judged by the vendor's own heartbeat rule or by the integration's documented time window.
population: the agents registered to the connected endpoint-protection tenant; every agent the read lists, or the vendor's own total for the tenant
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete, successful read of the tenant's agent population that states how many are not checking in (0 when none). A response that does not carry the figure, an error or refused answer, or a tenant with no agents cannot show 0 and is not measured.
citations: safeguards/epp/halcyon/offlineSensorCount.py (Halcyon public OpenAPI, GET /search/devices/metrics, DeviceMetrics.no_heartbeats; the vendor does not publish its heartbeat window, so the figure is the vendor's as given)
safeguards/epp/sentinelone/offlineSensorCount.py (existing implementation; counts agents inside a 15-day window that report inactive; not reviewed for this entry)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Halcyon transform can emit it. The meaning is the key name made precise; the other implementations of this name (SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, NinjaOne, Trend Vision One) were not reviewed for this entry, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Halcyon reports a vendor-defined no-heartbeat count with no per-device timestamp in the same call, so devices long gone cannot be split out as stale; an implementation that can read a per-agent last-seen time should report stale agents as a separate figure.
